notes.title: Release-Date
notes.notes:
Its official! Bezirk goes live first time on Christmas! We´re happy to announce this. The Version that we release is the 0.4 Beta. Also called the first basic-game-version. 

Greetings - fren

notes.title: Preparing for release.
notes.notes:
Hello Fellas from Bezirk!

We´re preparing for the first release of our game "Bezirk". Of course we will include english and german language at first. Other Languages are moving forward later. But we focus first on our main game. More news soon..

- fren
